name: ascii-text
title: ASCII Text
description: A word drawn as a grid of characters, sampled from the word's own letterforms; it settles out of character noise when it enters the screen.

meta.reducedMotion: The finished character drawing, with no noise.
meta.useWhen: The concept is code, print terminals, telegrams, early computing or textile grids; one short word at display size.
meta.avoidWhen: Anything longer than about 12 characters; small sizes (it becomes noise); as the only copy of important text.
